data.title: Allconnect™ Earns Its Highest ACSI® Score in Company History, Delivering Eight Straight Years of Industry-Leading Customer Experience
data.description: In Fort Mill, South Carolina, Allconnect, a prominent consumer platform aiding customers in comparing and accessing home services, achieved a record-high 2025 American Customer Satisfaction Index (ACSI®) score of 89. This marks the highest score in the company's history, surpassing that of over 450 companies reported across 43 industries in 2025. Allconnect's 89 rating concludes an impressive eight-year streak during which it consistently outperformed or equaled the highest ACSI score.

data.title: Toll Brothers Announces Opening of Two New Home Collections in Bickford Ranch Master Plan near Sacramento, California
data.description: A new development called Hillside and Crestview at Bickford will be hosting a special Hard Hat Tour Event on Saturday, September 19. The event marks the opening of the development to the public and will offer guests a chance to tour the site while it is still under construction. This event is a unique opportunity for interested individuals to get a sneak peek at the new development before its completion.
